snippet.title: [UR] PMWC at EWC 26 Finals D2 | PUBG MOBILE WORLD CUP at 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP
snippet.description:
Paris. $3,000,000. One Crown. PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup ke Finals jari hain!

PUBG MOBILE World Cup at 2026 Esports World Cup apne sab se aham marhale mein dakhil ho chuka hai. Aaj Paris mein Finals Day 2 ka aaghaz ho raha hai! Kai dinon ki sakht competition ke baad duniya ki top 16 teams ne glory, legacy aur $3,000,000 ke prize pool ke sab se bade hissa ke liye yahan tak ka safar tay kiya hai.

Yehi woh lamha hai jiske liye har team ne mehnat ki hai, aur ab Finals ka ek din guzar chuka hai. Group Stage ki behtareen teams aur Survival Stage se qualify karne wali teams ek baar phir saal ke sab se intense showdown mein aamne saamne hongi. Teen din, SMASH RULE, aur sirf ek champion.

Safar aaj ek naye marhale mein dakhil ho raha hai, kyun ke aakhir mein sirf ek hi team trophy uthayegi aur apna naam PUBG MOBILE ki tareekh mein hamesha ke liye likhwa degi. Finals Day 2 ka aaghaz ho chuka hai!

🔥 SMASH RULE kaise kaam karta hai?
Aaj ke matches (Finals Day 2) ke khatam hone ke baad Match Point Threshold ka taayun #1 ranked team ke total points +10 ke mutabiq kiya jayega. Jo team is threshold tak pohanch jayegi, usay kisi baad wale match ko jeetna hoga taake championship apne naam kar sake. Jis match mein team threshold hasil karegi, usi match ko jeetne se championship nahi milegi. Agar Match 18 tak koi team SMASH RULE ke zariye champion na ban sake, to phir standard rules ke mutabiq sab se zyada total points wali team champion qarar di jayegi.

🔥 PMWC at EWC 26 miss kyun nahi karna chahiye?

Duniya ki top 16 PUBG MOBILE teams ek hi stage par, koi second chance nahi!
Championship ki race mein har match bohat aham hai!
PUBG MOBILE ki tareekh bante hue apni aankhon se dekhein!
SMASH RULE ke sath pressure-packed, winner-takes-all action ka maza uthayein!

Duniya ki behtareen teams championship crown ke liye aamne saamne hain, lekin is baar ek naya twist hai. Kya champion ka faisla SMASH RULE ke zariye hoga?

Kai dinon ki sakht competition ke baad duniya ki top 16 PUBG MOBILE teams ne Finals mein apni jagah bana li hai. Ab har team glory, legacy aur $3,000,000 ke prize pool mein apne hissa ke liye muqabla karegi. Yehi woh lamha hai jiske liye har team ne mehnat ki hai. Group Stage ki behtareen teams aur Survival Stage se qualify karne wali teams ab saal ke sab se intense showdown mein aamne saamne hongi. Teen din, SMASH RULE, aur sirf ek champion.

Finals ke Day 2 ke baad Match Point Threshold ka taayun #1 ranked team ke total points +10 ke mutabiq kiya jayega. Jo team is threshold tak pohanch jayegi, usay Finals ke aakhri din kisi baad wale match ko jeetna hoga taake championship apne naam kar sake. Jis match mein team threshold hasil karegi, usi match ko jeetne se championship nahi milegi. Agar Match 18 tak koi team SMASH RULE ke zariye champion na ban sake, to phir standard rules ke mutabiq sab se zyada total points wali team champion qarar di jayegi.
